notes.title: The new game is now on Steam
notes.content:
For the last couple of months, I've been working on the pre-production and conceptualization of a new game – Magna Graecia. It is a relaxing, colorful and simplistic city-builder based on hex tiles.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1566830

Here's the short teaser video:
[previewyoutube=z90lRZhZ23Y;full][/previewyoutube]

If you're into this kind of game, make sure to wishlist & follow it on Steam to stay tuned!

notes.title: Space Kettle Update
notes.content:
I want to thank you for the support you have provided since the release of the game. The game does not stand still and is updated a little every day. Today I am also bringing in several new features.

• Save-load system, making it possible to start a new game or continue playing the latest save.
• macOS support (may be unstable, macOS users are welcome to report all the issues/bugs).
• Fixed the bug: The kettle unexpectedly starts constantly rotating on all 3 axes, making it hardly possible to play.

Thank you for playing!
